issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Can't handle animations with duplicated names when importing GLTF2 file

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Download my test gltf file: 
[test_unity_scene.zip](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/5056416/test_unity_scene.zip)

2. Try import the gltf file.
3. See aiNodeAnim instance. 

**Expected behavior**
GLTF2 could handle animations with duplicate node names. As in GLTF2 internals the primary key to refer to a node is glTF2::Object::id, not glTF2::Node::name.

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2796406/89887505-011d5900-dc01-11ea-8f85-1a12120fa497.png)

As you can see from VS Code that, the GLTF file has nodes with same name, but not in the same layer of hierarchy.

The issue is somehow related to: [Fix inconsistency between animation and node name in glTF2 Importer](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/pull/2433)
